propositions: The dedup key is currently predicted from a composition of fit/decode functions in the differ, but the send path re-derives it independently via a different composition in each adapter, causing drift when the two compositions diverge.
The mutation entry carries un-fitted body while the key is computed from fitted body, so the key predicts what the transport will send rather than being derived from the bytes actually sent.

Two structurally identical mutation-enactment consumers (create path in dispatch_one.py and update path in dispatch_apply_phases.py) must both read wire_body from the mutation entry and send it, to prevent one path from regressing after the fix.

fit_for_send must return both landed_text (the dedup key, byte-identical to marker-stripped decode of what the transport receives) and wire_body (the fitted pre-encode text), so the key is derived from actual sent bytes.
Re-fitting an already-fitted body via the adapter's fit_comment must be idempotent and return the body byte-identical, so the adapter's defensive fit cannot move bytes after the key is taken.
